extraction.notes: Coordinator-side removal logging is not stated in the vendored files (broker group coordinator is not vendored), so no removal-signal fact is reported. The client-side removal lines (SESSTMOUT at src/rdkafka_cgrp.c:5724, MAXPOLL at :4984) are the client's own detections and are recorded as failure-detector facts. Heartbeat is suppressed once max.poll.interval.ms is exceeded (src/rdkafka_cgrp.c:3287).

facts.subject: session.timeout.ms
facts.quotedToken: the broker will remove the consumer from the group
facts.note: Stated in the config description: the broker's group coordinator removes a member after no heartbeats within session.timeout.ms and triggers a rebalance.

facts.subject: session.timeout.ms
facts.note: rd_kafka_cgrp_session_timeout_check (src/rdkafka_cgrp.c:5699-5711) computes the timeout from group_session_timeout_ms (line 5711), which is the session.timeout.ms setting; on expiry the client revokes its assignment and rejoins.

facts.subject: max.poll.interval.ms
facts.note: rd_kafka_cgrp_max_poll_interval_check_tmr_cb (src/rdkafka_cgrp.c:4973) detects the overrun using rk->rk_conf.max_poll_interval_ms (line 4990) and then leaves the group.

facts.subject: rd_kafka_cgrp_heartbeat
facts.note: Called from rd_kafka_cgrp_join_state_serve (src/rdkafka_cgrp.c:5771-5814), which runs from rd_kafka_cgrp_serve; that function is documented 'Called from main thread' (line 6229). Application message processing enters via the consume queue (rd_kafka_consumer_err enqueues to rkcg_q, line 4992). Heartbeats stop once RD_KAFKA_CGRP_F_MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED is set (line 3287).
